subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Which public sub-agent completion-announcement control should OpenClaw support for deterministic suppression: per-spawn only, config default, or a unified announce policy that also composes with parent and per-channel routing?
rationale: The missing behavior is real in source, but adding public tool/config surface overlaps open per-channel and parent-routing requests, and repository policy treats config/default/tool API changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Per-spawn suppression first
options.body: Expose a default-preserving `sessions_spawn` suppression policy and defer global/per-channel defaults until maintainers settle the broader config shape.

options.title: Config plus per-spawn override
options.body: Add `agents.defaults.subagents` policy and a per-call override together, with explicit precedence, docs, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Defer to routing design
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for broader `announceTarget` and per-channel suppression decisions before adding a public surface.

recommendation.title: Per-spawn suppression first
recommendation.body: Expose a default-preserving `sessions_spawn` suppression policy and defer global/per-channel defaults until maintainers settle the broader config shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history signal for the spawn/announce public API and config compatibility decision.
